name: friday.l1.files.write_notes
precondition: path is a non-empty string resolving to a file within the allowed notes directory; text is a non-empty string
postcondition: Writes text to the specified path, overwriting any existing content. Returns a confirmation string.
failure_mode: PreconditionError if the path does not exist or is not writable, or if the directory is not in the allowed notes directory
returns: str: absolute path of the written file
